comment: Upstream watermarks for the update-patterns skill. Each entry records the last upstream commit whose behaviour was reconciled with this catalog. Update last_checked_commit only after the affected concepts were re-read and corrected (or confirmed still correct).

sources.notes: Reconciled through keiki 0.8.0.0 (release commits 7c5d433, 9ee8de0). 0.7: Keiki.ProjectionDomain, ExactFieldProjection/exactFieldWitness and the checkFieldProjection* laws, the conservative reclassification of one-way fieldWitness projections, verifyPredicateDetailed/predicateTranslationReport, and the detailed step and replay attribution APIs. 0.8: Show on lit plus opaqueLit/TOpaqueLit, and readable-by-default Mermaid with MermaidUpdateMode/toTopologyMermaid. Watch paths corrected: the library is src/, not the keiki-core and keiki-diagrams directories the previous entry named, so earlier --files scoping under-reported the diff.

Reconciled through keiro 0.6.0.0 (release commit 9177930, tagged as one five-package set): the source-language contract, consumer-owned nominal bindings, and authoritative version-2 scalar aggregate expressions were added as new concepts; 0.5.0.0's service workspaces were already covered. Runtime packages carry no behaviour change beyond keiki >=0.6 bounds and keiro-core's new Keiro.Codec.Nominal; the bulk of the diff is the Fourmolu reformat.
